versions.changelog:
Initial release—introduces a comprehensive PRD assistant tailored for ToB SaaS products:

- Supports creation, review, and optimization of PRDs across three core scenarios: new product from scratch, new feature development, and existing feature iteration.
- Includes full-lifecycle PRD components: market research, value analysis, competitor benchmarking, feature design, upstream/downstream impact assessment, and release management.
- Features industrial-grade competitor screenshot analysis pipeline and a five-dimensional PRD review framework.
- Provides scenario-based templates, progressive guidance modes (quick start, standard, expert), and multi-role collaboration support.
- Offers multiple output formats (Markdown, Word, LeTuc/DingTalk Docs), and role-adapted PRD views for R&D, sales, and executives.
